QBZ-95.description:
A shift from earlier Novaruss-inspired designs, the QBZ-95 represents the People's Republic of Jinhan's first domestically developed family of small arms for the new 5.8x42mm round. The design includes a distinctive foregrip positioned just ahead of the pistol grip, improving handling during automatic fire.
 While the bullpup layout offers compactness, the QBZ-95 lacks modularity for mounting accessories - often requiring aftermarket kits to use them.

Community submitted model.
QBZ-95.name: QBZ-95

BREN 2.description:
A modular assault rifle developed from the VZ. 805 with an 11in. barrel. Combines a high rate of fire and a lightweight design to give the VZ. 806 somewhat above average recoil, but excellent overall handling and damage output.

Model submitted by Rialag.
BREN 2.name: BREN 2

C7A2.description:
A Cascadian iteration upon the Grand Federation military's M16A2. Features a full auto trigger group, speedy reload, and an integrated optic.
This gun reminds you of a simpler time.
C7A2.name: C7A2

SCAR-L.description:
A modular Belvaunian assault rifle, built specifically to satisfy the needs of SOCOM. Steady fire rate with low recoil and high minimum damage.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR-L.name: SCAR-L

AUG A1.description:
The Alpenstahlan bullpup universal assault rifle with a built-in telescopic optic. Decently accurate with a long range and above-average fire rate.
Press T and aim to use the long range scope!

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A1.name: AUG A1

VHS-D2.description:
A Kravena bullpup assault rifle with a strong external resemblance to the FAMAS.
It deals higher than average headshot damage with a high fire rate, bullet speed and controllable recoil but has lower than average body damage range.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
VHS-D2.name: VHS-D2

K2.description:
A moderized Seongho Assault Rifle stemming from the K1A carbine.
The K2 trades close range performance for a long range preference. However, it does lean into close range with its damage done to the torso.
K2.name: K2

BREN 3.description:
A further modernization of the Korvan VZ.806 rifle system with a redesigned upper receiver and various other improvements to the firearm to increase reliability and improve performance.

High rate of fire with relatively good damage, but somewhat higher recoil.
Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
BREN 3.name: BREN 3

MAX-11/15.description:
A Grand Federation upgrade kit for the MAC-11 designed to use AR-15 parts and magazines. Used as a way for the everyman to have a cheaper Automatic Rifle with existing machine guns without breaking the bank.

Model submitted by Vic.
MAX-11/15.name: MAX-11/15

FAMAS UNBULLPUP.description:
A strange design of the FAMAS in unbullpuped form, yet performs identically to the FAMAS F1.
Almost like it was meant as a joke?

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS UNBULLPUP.name: FAMAS UNBULLPUP

L85A2 UNBULLPUP.description:
A strange design of the L85A2 in unbullpuped form, yet performs identically to the L85A2.
Somehow functions unlike a certain L85A1...

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L85A2 UNBULLPUP.name: L85A2 UNBULLPUP

L85A3.description:
An upgrade to the Soveran L85A2 assault rifle as part of the SA80 family!
It has been officially issued in 2018 but the whole family is set to be replaced in the future. The A3 variant comes with modifications to the upper receiver and a full-length rail system
Average fire rate with high ranged damage, improved recoil and better handling over the A2.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L85A3.name: L85A3

FAMAS.description:
A Lysorian bullpup assault rifle.
One of the two main variants, both were accepted into the Lysorian military in the late 1978s and are being phased out slowly with the M416.
The FAMAS G2 uses M16-type 30rd STANAG magazines, has a larger handguard and fires faster than the F1 variant.
Burst fire reduces recoil by 20% and increases RPM by 100!

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
FAMAS.name: FAMAS

AK103.description: A further modernized version of the AK platform, brought into the modern day with a polymer handguard and stock. Trades a small amount of close-range performance for a range preference.
AK103.name: AK103
